ongoing.text: Review refinance rates quarterly across all mortgaged properties.
Walk every prospect in person before offering — no exceptions.

investing_rules: Underwrite every deal on cap rate first, appreciation potential second
Keep 6 months of reserves per property, not pooled across the portfolio
Never buy a value-add without a contractor bid already in hand
Walk away if the 1% rule isn’t even close
Refinance decisions wait for the rate + cash-out math, not vibes
Only one prospect gets serious diligence at a time
County records and comps beat an agent’s pitch deck every time
